summary: Abivax S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its annual ordinary and extraordinary general meeting of shareholders held on May 11, 2026. The filing details voting outcomes on 19 agenda items, including approval of financial statements, director reappointments, executive compensation, share buyback authorization, and capital increase delegations. All items passed with varying support, notably director renewals and compensation policies receiving 77–80% approval. Participation was 86.06%. This is a routine shareholder meeting disclosure, not a special situation event. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special-situation corporate action is involved.
